demand_factor.interpretation: Descriptive association; not causal or independent of other inputs

unavailable_count.interpretation: Descriptive association; not causal or independent of other inputs

failure_taxonomy.cascade: Not modelled: static transport cannot establish temporal cascading failure

analysis.assumptions: Common random numbers; fresh IID synthetic inputs. Paired normal intervals are asymptotic, not exact binomial intervals.
analysis.recovery: Untested: no storage, repairs or time dynamics in capacity model

limitations: Numerical steady-state capacity model, not hydraulics
